sloka: नूनम् कांचन पृष्ठस्य विकृष्टस्य मया रणे ।द्रष्टुम् इच्छसि चापस्य रूपम् विद्युत् गण उपमम् ॥४-३०-७३॥
transliteration: nūnam kāṁcana pṛṣṭhasya vikṛṣṭasya mayā raṇe ।draṣṭum icchasi cāpasya rūpam vidyut gaṇa upamam ॥4-30-73॥

translations.english: 'Even the carnivorous animals dislike to eat the body of such ungrateful men who do not help their friends even though they have received help and have achieved their objective.'
